latestTerminalSummary:
Done. Full ER11 B-06/treatment/research assignment executed inside one native Goal, all science saved before terminal completion at 20:51 UTC, 46 minutes before the 21:37 deadline.

Top finding: the independent critic proved two material defects in my draft — an internally inconsistent Owner-context export (an Owner can read the data the export must omit) and misaligned source-ID labels in frozen discovery §3 — and I withdrew/replaced the export mechanism and published an alias correction table rather than rewriting frozen files.

Artifacts in `/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-06/treatment/research/`:
- `discovery.md` (30.9 KB, frozen pre-reveal, hash unchanged), `source-map.json` (19 sources S01–S19, valid JSON), `sources/` (19 evidence files + index + fetch-time ledger)
- `revealed-plan.md` (P1–P6, read only after freeze), `draft.md` (22.8 KB per-P disposition)
- `final.md` (38.8 KB, self-contained: corrected P1–P6 verdicts, findings, conditions, alternatives incl. critic-sourced spreadsheet/Spinitron screening leads, optionals, D1/D2/P6 user decisions, uncertainties, revised V1–V9 proposed validations vs executed static checks, 15-point critique disposition, alias table, O1–O6 check)

Verified by observation: discovery/draft hashes match the freeze record and the critic's reviewed inputs; critic READY.json hashes matched before reading; no runtime tests exist or were claimed — all V-checks honestly proposed, usage/billing null throughout.
